native_mechanisms: A glint leaves the source jewel and crawls along every cord at a speed set by that cord's length, so arrival time equals accumulated cord length (delay-based wavefront propagation).
Each jewel's square is chalked at its first flare only; any later flare arriving down a longer/slacker cord is discarded unmarked (first-arrival-wins, settle once).
Any square never lit by any flare is left blank and crossed out (unreachable nodes marked as infinity).
core_technique: Dijkstra's algorithm over a CSR adjacency structure with an unordered frontier array whose minimum is found by a blocked (64-entry) block-minimum cache and AVX2/SIMD linear min-and-find scans instead of a binary heap.
